name: Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund
oneLiner: SPKCC is the USD share class of Spiko's regulated French AIF combining a digital-asset cash-and-carry basis strategy with short-duration T-bill collateral.
collateral: USD share class of the Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund. Monthly allocation rotates between BTC and ETH cash-and-carry (basis) trades and short-duration Treasury bills/cash. Marex is the fund's sole strategy counterparty, spot digital assets are custodied at Coinbase, futures are cleared on CME, and CACEIS Bank (Credit Agricole Group) acts as depositary.
pegMechanism: USD-denominated NAV-accreting fund share; daily NAV is calculated by CACEIS Fund Administration and published on-chain through a Chainlink AggregatorV3-style oracle contract. Holdings are restricted to KYC-allowlisted addresses via Spiko's PermissionManager; minting is limited to the daily-operator role and burns to the Redemption contract's burner role.

oracleRisk.summary: SPKCC publishes its fund NAV on-chain through a Chainlink AggregatorV3-style oracle, so valuation depends on an external feed. It is a permissioned fund share rather than a borrower CDP, and no token-level collateral liquidation path is documented.

branchApplicability.rationale: Spiko describes SPKCC as a regulated fund share whose strategy rotates between BTC or ETH cash-and-carry trades and Treasury bills. Primary-market access is permissioned and fund NAV is calculated and published for the share; tokenholders do not open borrower-owned collateral positions, so there are no SPKCC collateral-market or liquidation branches to inventory.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: SPKCC is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: SPKCC mint/burn routes through Spiko's PermissionManager (ERC1967Proxy) on each EVM chain. Mint requires PermissionManager group 0 (ADMIN) or group 2 (daily-operator). Group 2 is a rotating Spiko EOA; group 0 ADMIN is the Spiko admin Safe 0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea (3/8, verified on-chain 2026-07-20). Polygon/Base deployments share the Ethereum PermissionManager address; Arbitrum uses a chain-local proxy to the same implementation; Starknet/Stellar deployments were verified 2026-07-20.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager (ERC1967Proxy) — shared authority policy
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, ERC1967 impl = 0xd3f5f1524e1a472b51374a3ff41b8936eb5b658e (PermissionManager). Group structure: group 0 = ADMIN (controls everything), group 2 = daily-operator/minter, group 5 = KYC operator (manages group 6 user allowlist). Group 2 admins = group 0 only; getGroupAdmins(0) = {0} (self-referential). 2026-07-20 (block 25571110): group 0 holder identified — getGroups(0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea) returns the group-0 bitmap, and the address is a Gnosis Safe proxy (171-byte bytecode) with getThreshold() = 3 and getOwners() = 8 signers (0x75e0092e7d2c8d854fcf5334f95554852d62746a, 0xe9106c617d7180bf6badcfa5edc664b726c5dcbb, 0x6c00be5d1013a5bca938ef6aa8f1e5e706ff384d, 0x4d1d9c5b5d9ca448194313d799de374f362bd460, 0x0da47bd72438f11bef7cc54f18cd02426dd86a5a2, 0xe67d2cbeae3090be017c66e7a6943961619a5d350, 0x4896f23ff83242d8d4eb5fa1dedf8c57e9145949, 0xa6e06dfe42064b7cd6dc902a62e74ca5bb574011) — the same Spiko admin Safe enumerated in the EURSPKCC 2026-07-15 sweep.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: SPKCC is issued natively by Spiko on all six chains: every deployment was re-verified on-chain 2026-07-20 as the canonical Spiko fund share (EVM authority() = Spiko PermissionManager; Starknet owner = Spiko's Starknet owner account; Stellar contract in Spiko's official stellar-contracts registry). Cross-chain transfers run over Chainlink CCIP, Spiko's documented interoperability rail, so the profile tier reflects an external validated-network transfer rail over issuer-native deployments.

reserveReview.reviewer: SOL-III Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: Spiko's current producer reports the SPKCC fund as one cash-and-carry strategy envelope, not a defensible fixed 80/20 allocation. The direct exposure is classified as hedged crypto with basis, venue, custody, liquidity, counterparty, smart-contract, and concentration risks retained.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact live SPKCC aggregate and official cash-and-carry fund disclosure
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The strategy envelope is identified, but current spot, derivative, collateral, venue, and liquidity-buffer weights are not published by the aggregate feed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The aggregate feed does not split current spot, derivative, margin, venue, and liquidity-buffer exposures.
